reading.body:
This entry documents a downtown Albuquerque office tower at 505 Marquette Avenue NW that carries an OpenStreetMap telecom tag but publishes no data center specifications. The building's name matches its street address, a naming pattern typical of multi-tenant office towers rather than purpose-built data centers, which operators typically brand with distinctive names. The telecom tag most likely reflects a telecommunications equipment room or meet-me point within the building, not a colocation or cloud data center business.

No megawatt capacity is published for this facility. New Mexico has 14 mapped facilities on record but zero published megawatt figures across the state, meaning this site cannot be ranked against peer capacity in the region or used to assess the state's contribution to AI infrastructure scaling.

This entry does not represent a data center campus material to AI compute deployment. It is a downtown office building with internal telecom infrastructure, not a purpose-built facility sized or positioned to serve large-scale compute workloads.
